(2) "they are the arms that withhold on substance" reads as exclusive, and result 3 of the same card says "both 410 writes at parity do the same (16:5, 15:2)". Those counts are significant (p = 0.027 and 0.0023). The paper confines its claim with "at p ≤ 0.001" and gives the 410 arms their own clause, "withhold on 15 and 16 pairs". - It says "a plain partner" without saying what that is.
- It does not say that the 410 intervals are also clear of zero.
- It sets 21/19 against 16/15 without the spread the paper itself asks to be read with. The paper's limitations say the two full-width recipes, each trained twice, "differ between runs by up to five adjudicated withholdings".
